notes.title: Without Within 3 Chinese translation!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32534187/fcbd7a84594fbef316b7049a00967eb7e75d848b.jpg[/img]

Hi friends ːcleahappyː! Long time no talk. Hope you have all been staying safe and positive during these tough times.

Without Within 1 and 2 both featured Chinese translations. Back then, it was viable to make money from all ages visual novels. The scene has changed since then, which was why WOWI 3 was only available in English. I thank you for your understanding at that time. And, to those who are happy with how things have been since my move to traditional games, I am grateful ːyoyoː.

Thankfully, Molchunya has offered to translate Without Within 3, and now, the update is up! Thank you to all the Chinese gamers for your support through these years. Also, I appreciate your patience until now ːwhappyː.

Without Within 3, along with all my other games, are currently on sale:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/InvertMouse]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/InvertMouse[/url]

My latest game, Clea, is playable in Chinese and many other languages. I hope you can give it a go!

Thank you everyone ːvintysmileː.

notes.title: Wish for Rain Week
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29513618/bdb2886004af085dcaf45f6ba93f5c8c2e36a2c5.jpg[/img]

Hiya friends ːvintysmileː.

As you may have seen, things have not been great here in Australia. Our bushfires have slaughtered millions of wildlife. Countless families have lost their homes, and some unfortunately did not make it at all.

The air here has also been awful on many days, including in the cities where most of us work at our day jobs. We have been advised to put on masks when we are out and about. The smoke is at times so thick it feels like we are in Silent Hill.

Well, time to take action. This week, all profits made from my portfolio (from Unhack to Clea) will be donated to the Australian Red Cross Disaster Relief and Recovery:

[url=https://www.redcross.org.au/campaigns/disaster-relief-and-recovery-donate]https://www.redcross.org.au/campaigns/disaster-relief-and-recovery-donate[/url]

To mark the occasion, please hop onto Clea's main menu screen to download this "Wish for Rain" costume:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966737/473c426983e801878136df6fa7de81ee33aa71c0.jpg[/img]

From early December to this day, we have seen only small amounts of rain. Instead, we have regular strong winds, which as you can imagine, is no help to say the least when it comes to fires. Fortunately, we have some heavy rains forecasted for next week. Everyone now wishes this will indeed come true.

Of course, it is probably more direct to just donate, so please feel free to do that. To those who are interested in my portfolio, you can find it here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2684/InvertMouse_Bundle/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2684/InvertMouse_Bundle/[/url]

Thank you ːcleanormː!

notes.title: Unlikely inspiration
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/e9e34e50af7b26f8ccb0851763a85364b8b5c855.jpg[/img]

My mum loves Chinese Opera. If you have no idea what that is, I would not blame you. After all, their events do not always fill out stadiums. Not anymore, at least.

During a Singapore trip with the fam, I had begun to plan out WOWI 3. Meanwhile, there was a Chinese Opera show going on, and we made sure Mum would get to attend.

That afternoon, I met up with a couple of online friends to hang out. Afterward, I joined my mum for some Chinese Opera. I arrived, and there the actors were, exactly as they typically appeared on those VHS tapes Mum used to watch. These actors must have rehearsed vigorously to prep for this show. Let’s hope lots of people rock up!

Oh, just Mum, my brother, me, plus 3 to 4 others in attendance.

Well, the show must go on, and we made sure to stay for the whole thing. That night, I jotted a reminder for myself. During those Kiki VS Excelia calligraphy battles, make sure to mention the majority of people do not care in the slightest. Vinty, at least for now, has opted to continue her niche calligraphy pursuits. For that, she has my respect.

Whenever I want to let go of that gas pedal, I would remember those Chinese Opera actors from Singapore. They have no idea, but they have become an unlikely source of motivation.

Because above all else, they love what they came on this earth to do.

notes.title: The future of Without Within (struggle is real)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/860fbebc8e56b72ec3551248288dff6e9df3b0c7.jpg[/img]

Recently, a reader asked about the possibility of a Without Within 1 and 2 remaster. Makes sense, since I would do a far better job now compared to 3-4 years ago.

That is, assuming I have the required budget, and unfortunately, in this saturated market (one that is niche to start with), I lack the sales numbers to justify such an endeavor :vintydread:.

First, I want to say thank you to everyone who sends me these messages. I still get emails telling me Without Within, especially the first one, has inspired people to pursue their dreams. If money were a non-issue, that would be enough fuel for me to continue.

And now, back to the topic at hand. If Vinty's adventures were to continue, some major changes must be in order. Here are a few ideas:

[b]Light novels:[/b]

Before Steam Greenlight became a thing, I had spent 10-12 years writing away, hoping to one day complete a novel of publishable standard. If I continued the WOWI series in novel, or at least novella format, that could allow me to fulfil that dream. Light novels, after all, would be far cheaper to produce.

[b]Format shifts[/b]:

Alternately, WOWI could remain in visual novel form. It will, however, need to go through drastic format changes. Have you played Narcissu? It would be more along those lines. Less images, and the text takes center stage. To many players, this will be seen as a downgrade. 

[b]Translations:[/b]

Here comes another hurdle—translation costs. Without Within 1 and 2 featured Chinese translations, but not the third instalment. As a script expands, translation costs also balloon. Visual novels contain more text than traditional games, which restricts localization possibilities.

[b]Full circle:[/b]

The first game I published on Steam was Unhack, which attempted to combine storytelling and gameplay. By the way, did you know I program for my day job? In fact, I have loved to code since around 8-9 years old.

With that said, I would like to come full circle and once again put those skills to use. And so, for the foreseeable future, I am going back to traditional games.

[b]Clea:[/b]

I would like to introduce you to Clea, a horror title I have been working on:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7686208/9b7eeb7428370f16e227a98e9785e06ed66884e6.jpg[/img]

There is currently a prototype available, with a limited time to submit feedback and have your name listed under special thanks:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/981020/announcements/detail/1708449632692798961]https://steamcommunity.com/games/981020/announcements/detail/1708449632692798961[/url]
Official webpage (with prototype links):

[url=http://clea.invertmouse.com]http://clea.invertmouse.com[/url]

[b]Closing thoughts:[/b]

In summary, the Without Within series cannot continue in its current format. Still, I would love to hear your thoughts and ideas. I hope you can share them with me in the comments below.

Thank you so much! Vinty and I thank you :vintysmile:.

notes.title: Without Within 3: Deleted scene
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/7214ca57fe06e8907431f97dfcd7a84c143780d6.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! Thank you to those who have picked up Without Within 3 so far. Remember, once you complete the game, please consider leaving a Steam review to help other players out :excelia:.

I delete mercilessly during the editing phase. Words, sentences, and even entire scenes will be removed if I decide they are merely padding. That said, have you ever loved a character so much you want to know everything about him/her? I want to offer something extra for those who want just a little more.

And so, here is a deleted segment from Without Within 3. This scene takes place early in the story when Vinty is waiting for her flight to Singapore. Enjoy :vintysmile:!

* * *

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/8777c76bfc0ae1163d208c692efe7123129e1a63.jpg[/img]

I stroll to my gate and wait for the plane to arrive. As I sit alongside my fellow passengers, their voices drown out, and my mind once again drifts.

A part of me wishes I'd received a ticket back to Melbourne instead. Adults should pursue new experiences, but I often get stuck in the past. How should I put it? It's like having that sudden urge to catch up with old friends.

I flip through my photos once in a while, but nothing beats being there in person. That dark and cold walk to my hotel felt like a nightmare, yet now I can reflect and smile at my foolishness.

Then there are the people. People like Grace, that lady who runs the restaurant near my hotel. I wonder if Grace will remember me next time. Probably not, but I hope she'll continue to laugh with her customers, sometimes letting a naughty word slip.

I pull out my wallet to see the Myki card tucked inside. Melbourne will always be the stage of my first adventure, but I told myself I'd only return as a calligraphy star, and I intend to keep that vow.

* * *

Thank you everyone! I want to share with you my future plans with visual novels, so I hope to be in touch again fairly soon :vintypretty:.

notes.title: Chinese translation update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/8822f8b127d73259f013c925ebd295b659d0cd09.jpg[/img]

Thank you to everyone who has purchased the game so far! I hope you will enjoy your time in Singapore and Malaysia this weekend :excelia:.

Again, I sorry to the Chinese-speaking gamers who have been looking forward to this release. Remember how short the first Without Within was? That was the reason I could afford to pay for translations. After that, truth be told, Without Within 2 was already a struggle, and now, since Without Within 3 is double the length of the second game, I am trapped in a tough spot for this series. Perhaps Excelia will need to be in some sexy commercials to make these games sell better, but you know the drill; sorry to disappoint :vintydelusional:.

For now, I want to give my heartfelt thanks to Molchunya, who has taken matters into his/her own hands:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/molchunya/recommended/676130/]https://steamcommunity.com/id/molchunya/recommended/676130/[/url]

Molchunya has provided Chinese translations for the demo version. A link can be found in the above review. As for the full game, since it is fairly long, I am already grateful for where we are at now. If I catch any updates, I will make sure to pass the message along.

Thank you so much Molchunya :vintysmile:!

P.S. Thank you also to the Chinese players who have been such good sports about this. This series is already niche, so if there are any negative bombs, Vinty's adventures may be forever ruined.

notes.title: Quick Q&A
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/e9e34e50af7b26f8ccb0851763a85364b8b5c855.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone :vintysmile:. Vinty's third adventure kicks off in less than four days! With that on the horizon, I want to answer a few questions that will no doubt pop up on release date.

* * *

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/e5dcb54243b2ececd800014930b3e05d84e14c27.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]1) Chinese translations:[/b][/h1]

I am deeply sorry to say there are no Chinese translations available this time around. There are several reasons for this:

[u]Reason 1:[/u] WOWI 3's script is double the length of WOWI 2's, so translation costs will be bumped up accordingly.

[u]Reason 2:[/u] With WOWI 2, I had received some feedback regarding the quality of the Chinese translations. My Chinese knowledge is limited, so I unfortunately cannot review the script on my own.

[u]Reason 3:[/u] As hinted above, I cannot cover the translation costs for such a niche series. I love Vinty as much as anyone, and I hope someday, our community as a whole will have a bigger reach.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/ea342c9dfd8533d26f60b9cb5e6b066c5a63875c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]2) Trading cards:[/b][/h1]

I have trading cards, emoticons and badges ready for WOWI 3 :excelia:! However, Steam has updated its trading card policy recently:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/1954971077935370845]https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/1954971077935370845[/url]
At the moment, Without Within 3 has been marked as not eligible for trading cards. Hopefully post release, the situation can be improved, then I can submit the pack for approval from Valve.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/23619ba006ddb482a0101696f413792812108d30.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]3) DOES SHE GET NEKKID???[/b][/h1]

Oh, you be wondering? Sorry to disappoint :sasalewd:.

* * *

Thank you! See you in Singapore and Malaysia :vintydelusional:.

notes.title: Without Within 3: Location scouting
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/23619ba006ddb482a0101696f413792812108d30.jpg[/img]

Without Within 3 takes place in Singapore and Malaysia. As Vinty travels to different locations, players will be able to view the real-life counterparts via YouTube.

When we use real locations, there is an extra layer of complexity involved. Is it okay to feature these iconic sights in your game? Hey, just ask. Look up a website, and chances are, there will be an address you can use to contact the staff.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/25b1fc78c17a47be969bf7b86a7d49d5e63f7a2a.jpg[/img]

Some companies will straight up say yes, while others may ask some questions first. In WOWI3’s case, the illustrations often have to be sent over for approval. It is better to take things one step at a time. If someone requests edits to your finalized artwork, that would be a waste of both time and money.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/7aa44d8f7fc3fd8644a85c754f98ca7df5419303.jpg[/img]

By the time I sent out permission requests for Without Within 3, I had already returned from Singapore and Malaysia. Several companies had offered to grant me free entry into their venues (for research), but I was unable to take advantage of these offers. You may want to take this into consideration for your own projects.

Please look forward to Without Within 3 :excelia:!

notes.title: Muse
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32534187/ea342c9dfd8533d26f60b9cb5e6b066c5a63875c.jpg[/img]

I am not romantic enough for the muse, so I instead focus on research and practice. That way, when the time comes to execute, I will have my fundamentals to rely upon. For Without Within 3, however, things were a bit different.

I was on a trip to Malaysia two to three years back. One night, I came across a beach in Penang, and things suddenly clicked. How about a calligrapher ghost sighting? Who, what, how—the hard work came afterward with conscious plotting, but the initial concepts had flooded in without effort.

From that moment on, I started to study the benefits of the subconscious. Before the trip, I must have thought, “You know, a third game would be nice round about now.” Then I put that aside and let instincts go to work. When the time is right, I trust the answers will surface on their own.

I am still not romantic enough for the muse, but when it calls, I am running with it all the way.

Three weeks until Vinty's third adventure begins ːvintysmileː!
